evaluability.rule: on study through day 42 (end of cycle 1's dosing interval)
on study through day 126 (end of cycle 3's dosing interval)

recruitment.site_count: SITE_COUNT_UNKNOWN: averaged over the site counts of historical trials of the same phase

scenarios.how: patients failing only EL012 become eligible; enrolment rate scales with the eligible yield at a fixed screening throughput; their adverse-event and evaluability risk follows their age and sex as in the simulated patients
enrolment rate x 1.2^0.468 (the historical accrual model's site coefficient)
the planned window extended by 6 months
eligible candidates re-weighted to 37% from East Asia (from 17%)
enrolment held to 50% women; the scarcer sex limits accrual
one follow-up visit removed per patient; the simulated withdrawal rate does not depend on visit burden, so retention is unchanged

derivations.eligibility: each simulated candidate's eligibility outcome; sequential funnel removes a candidate at the first category it fails
derivations.gain_if_relaxed: candidates who fail only that criterion
derivations.evaluable: treated and on study through the endpoint's sampling day (end of treatment or death ends it); sample collection itself is not simulated
derivations.evaluable_probability: Bayesian bootstrap of the simulated patients (4,000 draws), joint across endpoints
derivations.recruitment: log-normal fitted to the planning report's historical accrual percentiles; duration = enrolment / rate
derivations.objectives: P(every evaluable count meets its requirement) x P(all primary hypotheses succeed at the design ratios)
